+require "fileutils"
+
+class EventImportsController < ApplicationController
+     before_action :require_completed_profile
+  before_action :require_admin
+  before_action :load_import_file, only: %i[preview confirm]
+
+  MAX_FILE_BYTES = 10.megabytes
+  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.csv .xlsx].freeze
+
+  def new
+  end
+
+  def create
+       file = params[:file]
+    return render_invalid("Please upload a .csv or .xlsx file.") unless valid_file?(file)
+    return render_invalid("File is too large (max 10 MB).") if file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES
+
+    token = SecureRandom.uuid
+    path = import_path(token)
+    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
+    File.binwrite(path, file.read)
+
+    redirect_to preview_event_import_path(token)
+  end
+
+  def preview
+       parser = EventImport::Parser.new(@path)
+       @requirements = Requirement.active.order(:id).to_a
+       @other_requirement_id = Requirement.find_by(name: "Other")&.id
+       @preview_rows = EventImport::Mapper.new(headers: parser.headers, rows: parser.rows).preview
+     rescue StandardError => e
+          Rails.logger.error("Event import preview failed: #{e.message}")
+       File.delete(@path) if File.exist?(@path)
+       redirect_to new_event_import_path, alert: "That file could not be read. Please check the format and try again."
+  end
+
+  def confirm
+       parser = EventImport::Parser.new(@path)
+    rows = EventImport::Mapper.new(headers: parser.headers, rows: parser.rows).preview
+
+    result = EventImport::Executor.new(
+      rows: rows,
+      assignments: assignment_params
+    ).call
+
+    File.delete(@path) if File.exist?(@path)
+
+    redirect_to events_path, notice: summary_message(result)
+  end
+
+  private
+
+       def valid_file?(file)
+            return false unless file.is_a?(ActionDispatch::Http::UploadedFile)
+         ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(File.extname(file.original_filename).downcase)
+       end
+
+  def render_invalid(message)
+       flash.now[:alert] = message
+    render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
+  end
+
+  def import_path(token)
+       Rails.root.join("tmp", "event_imports", "#{token}#{File.extname(params[:file].original_filename)}").to_s
+  end
+
+  def load_import_file
+       token = params[:token].to_s
+    unless token.match?(/\A[0-9a-f-]{36}\z/)
+         return redirect_to new_event_import_path, alert: "Invalid import."
+    end
+    @path = Dir.glob(Rails.root.join("tmp", "event_imports", "#{token}.*")).first
+    unless @path && File.exist?(@path)
+         redirect_to new_event_import_path, alert: "Import expired. Please upload again."
+    end
+  end
+
+def assignment_params
+     assignments = params[:assignments]
+  return {} unless assignments.respond_to?(:to_unsafe_h)
+
+  assignments.to_unsafe_h.each_with_object({}) do |(row_index, fields), acc|
+       next unless fields.is_a?(Hash) || fields.respond_to?(:to_unsafe_h)
+
+    fields = fields.to_unsafe_h if fields.respond_to?(:to_unsafe_h)
+    fields = fields.to_h unless fields.is_a?(Hash)
+
+    acc[row_index] = {
+      "requirement_id" => fields["requirement_id"],
+      "point_value" => fields["point_value"],
+      "other_type" => fields["other_type"]
+    }
+  end
+end
+
+     def summary_message(result)
+          parts = []
+     parts << "#{result.created} event#{'s' if result.created != 1} added"
+     parts << "#{result.updated} updated" if result.updated.positive?
+     parts << "#{result.skipped} skipped" if result.skipped.positive?
+     parts << "#{result.errored.size} had issues" if result.errored.any?
+
+     base = "Import complete: #{parts.join(', ')}."
+
+     if result.missing_coordinates.positive?
+          count = result.missing_coordinates
+     verb = count == 1 ? "needs" : "need"
+     base += " #{count} event#{'s' if count != 1} #{verb} a location pin — open the events list to add one."
+     end
+
+     base
+     end
+end

+require "cgi"
+
+module EventImport
+     class Executor
+          Result = Struct.new(:created, :updated, :skipped, :errored, :missing_coordinates, keyword_init: true)
+def initialize(rows:, assignments:)
+     @rows = rows
+  @assignments = (assignments || {}).transform_keys(&:to_i)
+                                  .transform_values { |v| v.respond_to?(:symbolize_keys) ? v.symbolize_keys : v }
+end
+
+def call
+     created = 0
+  updated = 0
+  skipped = 0
+  missing_coordinates = 0
+  errored = []
+
+  Event.transaction do
+       @rows.each do |row|
+            case row.status
+            when :skip
+                 skipped += 1
+            when :error
+                 errored << row
+            when :new
+                 event = create_event(row)
+              created += 1
+              missing_coordinates += 1 if event.latitude.nil?
+            when :update
+                 event = update_event(row)
+              updated += 1
+              missing_coordinates += 1 if event.latitude.nil?
+            end
+       end
+  end
+
+  Result.new(
+    created: created,
+    updated: updated,
+    skipped: skipped,
+    errored: errored,
+    missing_coordinates: missing_coordinates
+  )
+end
+
+       private
+
+            def create_event(row)
+                 attrs = event_attributes(row).merge(assignment_for(row))
+            Event.create!(attrs.merge(geocode_coordinates(attrs[:location])))
+            end
+
+
+            def geocode_coordinates(location)
+                 return {} if location.blank?
+
+                 results = Geocoding::Nominatim.new.search(location)
+                 return {} if results.empty?
+
+                 top = results.first
+                 { latitude: top[:latitude], longitude: top[:longitude] }
+                 rescue Geocoding::Error => e
+                      Rails.logger.warn("Geocoding failed for #{location.inspect}: #{e.message}")
+                 {}
+            end
+
+            def update_event(row)
+                 row.existing_event.update!(event_attributes(row))
+            row.existing_event
+            end
+
+       def event_attributes(row)
+            attrs = row.attributes.dup
+         attrs[:description] = CGI.unescapeHTML(attrs[:description].to_s)
+         attrs
+       end
+
+       def assignment_for(row)
+            assignment = @assignments[row.index] || {}
+         {
+           requirement_id: assignment[:requirement_id].presence,
+           point_value: (assignment[:point_value].presence || 1).to_i,
+           other_type: assignment[:other_type].presence
+         }.compact
+       end
+     end
+end

+module EventImport
+     class Mapper
+          Row = Struct.new(
+            :index, :raw, :attributes, :status, :errors, :existing_event,
+            keyword_init: true
+          )
+
+       APPROVED_STATUS = "Approved".freeze
+
+       COLUMN_MAP = {
+         "reference" => :external_reference,
+         "title" => :name,
+         "starts" => :starts_at,
+         "ends" => :ends_at,
+         "marketing blurb" => :description
+       }.freeze
+
+       LOCATION_COLUMNS = [ "location", "location detail" ].freeze
+
+       def initialize(headers:, rows:)
+            @headers = headers.map(&:to_s)
+         @rows = rows
+       end
+
+       def preview
+            @preview ||= @rows.each_with_index.map { |raw, i| build_row(i, raw) }
+       end
+
+       private
+
+            def build_row(index, raw)
+                 values = normalized_row(raw)
+              attrs = {}
+              errors = []
+
+              COLUMN_MAP.each do |col, field|
+                   raw_value = values[col].to_s.strip
+                next if raw_value.empty?
+
+                attrs[field] = case field
+                when :starts_at, :ends_at then parse_time(raw_value, col, errors)
+                else raw_value
+                end
+              end
+
+              attrs[:location] = build_location(values)
+              attrs[:description] = "Event details coming soon." if attrs[:description].blank?
+
+              status = status_for(values, attrs, errors)
+              existing = find_existing(attrs[:external_reference])
+
+              status = :update if status == :new && existing
+
+              Row.new(
+                index: index + 2,
+                raw: raw,
+                attributes: attrs,
+                status: status,
+                errors: errors,
+                existing_event: existing
+              )
+            end
+
+       def normalized_row(raw)
+            @headers.each_with_index.each_with_object({}) do |(header, i), acc|
+                 key = header.to_s.downcase.strip
+              acc[key] = raw[i].to_s
+            end
+       end
+
+def parse_time(value, column_name, errors)
+     parsed = Time.zone.parse(value)
+     if parsed.nil?
+          errors << "Could not parse #{column_name}: #{value.inspect}"
+     end
+     parsed
+   rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
+        errors << "Could not parse #{column_name}: #{value.inspect}"
+     nil
+end
+
+       def build_location(values)
+            parts = LOCATION_COLUMNS.map { |c| values[c].to_s.strip }.reject(&:empty?)
+         parts.join(" — ").presence
+       end
+
+def status_for(values, attrs, errors)
+     errors << "Missing reference" if attrs[:external_reference].blank?
+  errors << "Missing title" if attrs[:name].blank?
+  errors << "Missing start time" if attrs[:starts_at].blank?
+  errors << "Missing location" if attrs[:location].blank?
+
+  return :error if errors.any?
+
+  status_value = values["status"].to_s.strip
+  unless status_value.casecmp?(APPROVED_STATUS)
+       errors << "Status is '#{status_value.presence || 'blank'}', not Approved"
+    return :skip
+  end
+
+  :new
+end
+
+       def find_existing(reference)
+            return nil if reference.blank?
+         Event.find_by(external_reference: reference)
+       end
+     end
+end

+require "roo"
+
+module EventImport
+     class Parser
+          def initialize(path)
+               @path = path.to_s
+          end
+
+       def headers
+            @headers ||= spreadsheet.row(1).map(&:to_s)
+       end
+
+       def rows
+            @rows ||= (2..spreadsheet.last_row).map do |i|
+                 spreadsheet.row(i).map { |v| v.to_s }
+            end
+       end
+
+       private
+
+            def spreadsheet
+                 @spreadsheet ||= if File.extname(@path).downcase == ".csv"
+                      Roo::CSV.new(@path)
+                 else
+                      Roo::Excelx.new(@path)
+                 end
+            end
+     end
+end

+
+  def preview_row(status:, index: 2, attrs: {})
+       start_time = attrs.delete(:starts_at) || 1.week.from_now
+    end_time   = attrs.delete(:ends_at)   || start_time + 1.hour
+
+    EventImport::Mapper::Row.new(
+      index: index,
+      raw: [],
+      attributes: {
+        external_reference: "EVN-#{index}",
+        name: "Imported Event #{index}",
+        starts_at: start_time,

+        description: "Test event",

+      existing_event: nil
+    )
+  end
+
+  it "creates events for :new rows and returns count" do
+       rows = [ preview_row(status: :new, index: 2) ]
+    assignments = { 2 => { requirement_id: requirement.id.to_s, point_value: "2" } }
+
+    result = described_class.new(rows: rows, assignments: assignments).call
+
+    expect(result.created).to eq(1)

+  it "skips :skip rows" do

+
